question: In the frozen 125-case ICASSP2022 pure-far corpus, how much does the unchanged 80 Hz mic-only HPF alter pre-Activity mic energy and mic/reference ratio, and can that asymmetry explain cross-case public-DTD occupancy?

selection.rule: reuse the exact frozen PR #238/#239 inventory: all complete no-movement ICASSP2022 farend-singletalk mic+lpb pairs at the pinned source revision

hpf_observed_not_tuned.implementation: y[n] = x[n] - x[n-1] + r*y[n-1], r = exp(-2*pi*80/internal_rate)

observation_method.shadow_resampler: independent research-only ap_resampler_state_t driven by the exact mic input with unchanged stream-0 resampling
observation_method.shadow_hpf: independent research-only ap_hpf_state_t initialized at unchanged internal rate and run with unchanged ap_hpf_process
observation_method.post_hpf_crosscheck: compare shadow HPF output sample-for-sample with actual pipeline->mono in the one-mic BF-disabled baseline; report per-frame max absolute error
observation_method.pre_hpf_energy: mean square of shadow resampler output before HPF
observation_method.post_hpf_energy: mean square of shadow HPF output, which must reproduce actual Activity mic input

outputs: per-case full-clip public-DTD and existing Activity ratio summaries
per-case far-frame pre-HPF mic energy and post-HPF mic energy
per-case far-frame HPF energy ratio and delta dB distributions
per-case far-frame mic/reference ratio before and after HPF
cross-case Spearman associations between public-DTD occupancy and HPF energy change, pre-HPF ratio, and post-HPF ratio
shadow-HPF to actual pipeline mono max-absolute-error distribution
prohibited_actions: change HPF cutoff, coefficients, state, ordering, Sync, Activity, AEC, RES, NS, AGC, or VAD source
disable HPF in the production pipeline
apply pre-HPF audio to Activity or AEC
derive or search an HPF correction, DTD threshold, or gain-normalization constant
subsample or hand-pick cases after observing results
treat an association as a classifier, ranking, or source-candidate selector
relax pure-far, movement, echo-path-change, Hosted Real AEC, or other qualification gates
promote to HIL, Product Certification, release, or shipping
interpretation_rule: The diagnostic may determine the direction and magnitude of unchanged mic-only HPF energy asymmetry and its descriptive association with pure-far public-DTD occupancy. It cannot authorize changing HPF, DTD thresholds, gain normalization, or any source candidate.
